# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 28 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Aseneth's Song of Thanksgiving

---

**28:1** I will sing praise to the Lord God Most High, for he heard my voice when I cried to him, and he took notice of my humiliation and my affliction.

**28:2** He rescued me from the pit of the underworld and from the snares of the wicked one, and he brought me up from the darkness to the light.

**28:3** He healed my wounds and gave me new life, and he made me pure and whole again.

**28:4** He raised me up from my shame and covered me with his great mercy, and he turned my weeping into gladness.

**28:5** He gave me his servant Joseph as a husband and a companion in all my ways.

**28:6** Blessed is the name of the Lord God Most High, who does wonders for those who love him.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
